description: Minimum username length lowered from 6 to 5, so 5-character usernames are accepted
PBKDF2 iterations cut from 20000 to 1000, which weakens stored password hashes
write_to_file copies the text after the insertion point from one byte too far, so one character is lost
Chunk count rounds up one too many, so a file of exactly 1024 bytes gets an extra empty chunk
Chunk HMAC covers only the IV, so changes to the encrypted body go unnoticed
read_from_file no longer checks the meta digest against the Master File List
read_from_file rejects position == file size, so a zero-length read at the end of the file fails
